text:
Most models are built to generate text, creative content, or reason step-by-step. But not every task needs a written answer.

When a workflow or agent just needs to make a quick call, the Decisions API returns calibrated confidence scores (150–250 ms end-to-end) at $0.10 per 1M input tokens, making it nearly 5x more cost-efficient across the shared benchmark suite than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with the Interactions API.

text:
So how do your questions turn into a decision?

Instead of asking a model to describe a photo, you give it a checklist of yes/no, multiple-choice, and rating questions so it knows what to check and what action to take.

Here, Gemini Decision 1 scans 100 delivery photos in 4.5 seconds (nearly 4x faster than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite), answering 16 questions per photo at once:

📦 Is the box damaged? (yes/no)
🌧️ Is it under a porch? (yes/no)
⭐ What's the delivery quality? (0 to 3 rating)
⚡ What happens next? (routes to a claim review)

text:
By predicting how the same DNA is read differently from cell to cell, AlphaGenome 2 opens up entirely new possibilities for understanding human genetics.

It’s available now for non-commercial research via our API and interactive Colab tutorials. Find out more → https://t.co/cPOPD3cWYB

text:
Looking at a whole tissue at once is like looking at a blurry image: you get the visuals, but miss what’s happening inside individual pixels.

Trained on 100M+ profiles across 68 tissues, AlphaGenome 2 focuses on one cell type at a time, spotting nearly twice as many mutations that turn genes on and off as our previous model.

text:
The model also adapts to lab experiments on the fly with no retraining needed.

Researchers can plug in data from just a few dozen cells to see how DNA changes behave in specific moments, like:
🔘 Immune cells responding to a vaccine
🔘 Specific cells in the gut driving inflammatory disease
🔘 Stem cells maturing into blood cells
